The '''Throne Rocks''' was a formation of huge rocks that sat within the Great Chamber of the [[sun caves]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sedri/Legends|Sedri]]. The [[High Priest/Legends|High Priest]] [[Cardo (Sedrian)|Cardo]] and his son, [[Pek]], would often meditate on the mysteries of the [[Golden Sun]] at the Throne Rocks.<ref name="BGS" />
